explanation: The theorem says two library-specific functions (gapsw80_t9_completedDedekindZeta and gapsw80_t1_completedDedekindZeta) agree eventually near any s with Re s > 1. It is proved from the library's own pointwise equality gapsw80_t10_completedDedekindZeta_eq_T1, together with the open half-plane {Re > 1} and Filter.eventuallyEq_iff_exists_mem. Mathlib has no declaration about these functions. The only Mathlib content is the generic filter and openness glue, which does not count as a duplicate. I did not run a search of the Mathlib sources.
